## R_customR

**Custom functions for everyday R tasks**

[GitHub](https://github.com/nexusofthings/R_customR){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

A script of helpers I reuse. It currently includes `table_aum()`, a version of `table()` that always counts missing values, so gaps in a variable show up in the first frequency table you make.

```r
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexusofthings/R_customR/main/custom_functions.R")

table_aum(c("a", "b", NA, "a"))
```

---

## custom.rgs

**A package version of the same helpers** (in development)

[GitHub](https://github.com/nexusofthings/custom.rgs){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm}

An early-stage R package exporting `table_aum()` and `fbind()`, which combines two factors into one whose levels are the union of both.

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nexusofthings/custom.rgs")
```
